<thought>Based on the carbon NMR (a carbonyl at ~168 ppm and six aromatic carbons) and the mass spectrum showing an ion at m/z ≈ 121, which matches the deprotonated ion [M‑H]⁻ of benzoic acid (neutral mass ≈ 122 Da), the most plausible structure is benzoic acid. Its SMILES representation is “OC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>OC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
